newsitem.title: USA: Pediatric Services in national pact.
newsitem.headline: Pediatric Services in national pact.

text.p: Pediatric Services of America Inc said Thursday it had agreed on terms for a national contract to provide pediatric home care services for people enrolled in United Health Care health plans and other managed care products.
The contract would be effective August 1, 1997. It calls for providing nursing, infusion and home medical equipment for infants and children through age 18, the company said.
Pediatric Services shares were up 1-1/2 at 21-3/4 in Thursday afternoon trading.

United Health Care is one of the nation's largest managed care companies; about three to 3.5 million children would be covered under the three-year contract, said Stephen Mengert, the company's chief financial officer.
Mengert had no estimate on revenues and declined to comment on the earnings impact.
"We do feel very positive about the contract, and we hope it will be the start of a good relationship with United," Mengert said.
